blocks.text: Present Simple: I work, she works

**Present Simple** (oddiy hozirgi zamon) — doimiy holat, takrorlanib turadigan harakat va umumiy faktlar uchun. O'zbekchada bunga «ishla**yman**», «yasha**ydi**», «bor**amiz**» kabi shakllar mos keladi: «Men bankda ishlayman», «U Samarqandda yashaydi». 3-darsdagi Present Continuous (ishla**yapman**) — hozir davom etayotgan harakat, Present Simple esa — umuman, odatda, har doim bo'ladigan harakat. Shakli juda oddiy: fe'lning o'zi (work, live, like), faqat **he / she / it** bilan oxiriga **-s** qo'shiladi.

O'zbekchada fe'l har bir shaxsda o'zgaradi: ishlay**man**, ishlay**san**, ishlay**di**, ishlay**miz**. Inglizchada esa Present Simple'da faqat bitta qo'shimcha bor — **-s**, va u faqat **uchinchi shaxs birlikda** (he, she, it yoki bitta kishi / narsa) qo'shiladi. **everybody**, **everyone**, **nobody** ham birlik hisoblanadi: Everybody know**s** him. Ko'plikdagi otga (`-s` bilan tugagan) fe'lning `-s` i qo'shilmaydi: My friend live**s** here — My friend**s** live here.

Ko'pchilik fe'llarga shunchaki **-s** qo'shiladi. Lekin fe'l ba'zi harflar bilan tugasa, **-es** yoki **-ies** yoziladi — bu so'zni aytishni osonlashtiradi (wash**s** deb aytish qiyin, shuning uchun wash**es**). **have** fe'li noto'g'ri: he **has** («haves» emas).

rows: work → work**s**, live → live**s**, read → read**s**
miss → miss**es**, wash → wash**es**, watch → watch**es**, fix → fix**es**
study → stud**ies**, fly → fl**ies**, try → tr**ies**, cry → cr**ies**
play → play**s**, buy → buy**s**, enjoy → enjoy**s**

items.text: Our cat **catches** mice in the garden.

items: **Takroriy, odatiy harakatlar**: I **get up** at seven. She **goes** to the gym on Mondays. — kun tartibi, odatlar;
**Doimiy holat**: We **live** in Tashkent. He **works** in a hospital. — uzoq vaqt davomida o'zgarmaydigan narsalar;
**Umumiy faktlar va tabiat qonunlari**: Water **boils** at 100 degrees. The sun **rises** in the east. — har doim to'g'ri bo'lgan narsalar;
**Gapirayotgan paytdagi «so'z bilan harakat»**: I **promise**. I **agree**. I **apologise**. — bu yerda «va'da beraman» deyishning o'zi va'da berishdir, shuning uchun Continuous emas.

blocks.text: Qanchalik tez-tez: always, usually, often, sometimes, never

Takroriy harakat bilan ko'pincha chastota so'zlari keladi. Ular **asosiy fe'l oldida** turadi: She **always** walks to work. Lekin **am / is / are** dan **keyin**: He is **always** late. **never** o'zi inkor ma'nosini beradi, shuning uchun gapga boshqa inkor kerak emas: I **never** eat meat («Men hech qachon go'sht yemayman»). Gap oxirida esa vaqt iboralari keladi: **every day**, **on Mondays**, **in the morning**, **twice a week**. Chastota so'zlarining o'rni batafsil — 94-darsda.

items.text: Emma **usually** has lunch at her desk.
The trains are **often** late in winter.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «He work in a bank.» → **He works in a bank.** (`-s` unutiladi — eng ko'p uchraydigan xato); «She haves a car.» → **She has a car.**; «He studys» → **He studies**; «I am live in Tashkent.» / «I'm work.» → **I live in Tashkent.** / **I work.** (Present Simple'da **am / is / are** yo'q); «My friends lives here.» → **My friends live here.** (ko'plikda `-s` yo'q); «Everybody know him.» → **Everybody knows him.**
Eslab qolish: **he, she, it — s bilan ketadi**. Gapda egaga qarang: bitta kishi yoki narsa bo'lsa — fe'lga **-s**, ko'p bo'lsa yoki I / you / we / they bo'lsa — fe'l «yalang'och» qoladi.

Bog'lanish: inkor (I **don't** work, she **doesn't** work) — 6-dars; savol (**Do** you work? **Does** she work?) — 7-dars; Present Continuous bilan farqi (I **work** / I**'m working**) — 8-dars; jadval bo'yicha kelajak (The train **leaves** at 7) — 25-dars.

I get up at 7. Water boils at 100 degrees.
every day, on Mondays, twice a week

examples.title: **I / you / we / they** + verb: work, live, like
examples.description: I, you, we, they va ko'plik bilan fe'l o'zgarmaydi: I **work**, we **live**, they **like**. Bu — doimiy yoki takroriy harakatlar. O'zbekchada: ishla**yman**, yasha**ymiz**.

sentences.text: **I live** in a small flat in Chilanzar.
We **get up** at six on weekdays.
My parents **work** at the same hospital.
You **speak** English very well!
Tom and Emma **live** near the river in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Tom bilan Emma Oksfordda daryo yaqinida **yashaydi**.

sentences.text: In summer we **go** to my grandmother's village near Namangan.
I **drink** two cups of coffee every morning.
sentences.translation: Har kuni ertalab ikki piyola qahva **ichaman**.

sentences.text: Students at this school **wear** a uniform.
My friends and I **play** football every Sunday afternoon.
sentences.translation: Do'stlarim bilan har yakshanba tushdan keyin futbol **o'ynaymiz**.

sentences.text: Our neighbours **have** two dogs, and they **walk** them twice a day.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimizning ikkita iti **bor**, ularni kuniga ikki marta **sayr qildirishadi**.

examples.title: **He / she / it** + **-s**: works, lives, likes
examples.description: he, she, it va bitta kishi yoki narsa (my sister, the shop, Tashkent) bilan fe'lga **-s** qo'shiladi: she work**s**, it open**s**. Present Simple'dagi yagona qo'shimcha shu.

sentences.text: My sister **works** in a bank.
Aziz **likes** spicy food.
The shop **opens** at eight and **closes** at ten.
She **speaks** three languages: Uzbek, Russian and English.
sentences.translation: U uch tilda **gapiradi**: o'zbek, rus va ingliz tillarida.

sentences.text: Our teacher **comes** from Wales.
Every morning Grandpa **reads** the newspaper in the garden.
This bus **stops** right outside our school.
James **plays** the guitar, and his wife **sings**.
Madina **lives** in Samarkand, but she **works** in Tashkent.
It **rains** a lot in Manchester, so everybody **takes** an umbrella.
sentences.translation: Manchesterda yomg'ir ko'p **yog'adi**, shuning uchun hamma soyabon **olib yuradi**.

examples.title: Spelling: **watches**, **goes**, **studies**, **has**
examples.description: `-s`, `-sh`, `-ch`, `-x`, `-o` bilan tugagan fe'llarga **-es** (watch**es**, go**es**), undosh + `-y` → **-ies** (stud**ies**), have → **has**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **watches** cartoons with her son in the evening.
My brother **studies** medicine in Bukhara.
Dad **goes** to the gym three times a week.
sentences.translation: Dadam haftasiga uch marta sport zaliga **boradi**.

sentences.text: She **has** a lovely garden with lots of roses.
The baby **cries** when she's hungry.
Bekzod **fixes** computers for a living.
My grandmother **does** the washing on Mondays.
Emma **teaches** English, and her husband **flies** planes.
sentences.translation: Emma ingliz tilidan **dars beradi**, eri esa samolyot **uchiradi**.

sentences.text: Every evening Aziz **washes** the dishes and **tidies** the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Har kuni kechqurun Aziz idishlarni **yuvib**, oshxonani **yig'ishtiradi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **enjoys** her job, but she **misses** her family in Scotland.
sentences.translation: Sara ishini **yaxshi ko'radi**, lekin Shotlandiyadagi oilasini **sog'inadi**.

examples.title: Facts: things that are always true
examples.description: Umumiy faktlar, tabiat qonunlari va doimo to'g'ri bo'lgan narsalar ham Present Simple bilan aytiladi.

sentences.text: Water **boils** at 100 degrees Celsius.
The sun **rises** in the east.
Bees **make** honey from flowers.
Most people in Uzbekistan **speak** at least two languages.
The Thames **flows** through London.
A year **has** twelve months, and a week **has** seven days.
sentences.translation: Yilda o'n ikki oy, haftada esa yetti kun **bor**.

sentences.text: Plants **need** water and light.
In Uzbekistan people **celebrate** Navruz on 21 March.
Penguins **live** in cold places and **eat** fish.
The Earth **goes** round the Sun once a year.
sentences.translation: Yer Quyosh atrofini yiliga bir marta **aylanib chiqadi**.

examples.title: **always**, **usually**, **often**, **sometimes**, **never**
examples.description: Harakat qanchalik tez-tez bo'lishi: **always** (doim), **usually** (odatda), **often** (tez-tez), **sometimes** (ba'zan), **rarely** (kamdan-kam), **never** (hech qachon). Ular asosiy fe'l oldida, lekin **am / is / are** dan keyin turadi.

sentences.text: I **always** drink green tea after dinner.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatdan keyin **doim** ko'k choy ichaman.

sentences.text: Madina **usually** walks to work.
We **often** eat plov on Fridays.
My dad **never** drinks coffee in the evening.
**Sometimes** Tom cycles to the office.
Bekzod is **always** late for his lessons.
The children **usually** go to bed at nine.
It **often** snows in the mountains in January.
Sarah **rarely** watches TV — she prefers books.
sentences.translation: Sara televizorni **kamdan-kam** ko'radi — kitobni afzal ko'radi.

sentences.text: My grandparents **sometimes** visit us at the weekend, and we **always** cook something special.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvim dam olish kunlari **ba'zan** bizga kelishadi, biz esa **doim** maxsus taom pishiramiz.

examples.title: **every day**, **on Mondays**, **twice a week**
examples.description: Takroriy harakat bilan keladigan vaqt iboralari: **every** day / week / summer, **on** Mondays, **in** the morning, **once / twice / three times a** week.

sentences.text: **Every day** I walk my dog in the park.
The museum closes early **on Mondays**.
Dilnoza calls her mother **twice a day**.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza onasiga **kuniga ikki marta** qo'ng'iroq qiladi.

sentences.text: **In the morning** my brother runs five kilometres.
We visit Bukhara **every summer**.
Emma has piano lessons **once a week**.
sentences.translation: Emma **haftasiga bir marta** pianino darsiga boradi.

sentences.text: **On Fridays** the whole family meets at Grandma's house.
Aziz checks his emails **every hour** — it's a bad habit.
sentences.translation: Aziz elektron pochtasini **har soatda** tekshiradi — bu yomon odat.

sentences.text: The buses to the airport leave **every twenty minutes**.
**At the weekend** James sleeps late and cooks a big breakfast.
sentences.translation: **Dam olish kunlari** Jeyms kech turib, katta nonushta tayyorlaydi.

examples.title: **I promise**, **I agree**, **I think**
examples.description: Ba'zi fe'llar gapirayotgan paytdagi harakatni bildirsa ham Present Simple'da turadi: **I promise** (va'da beraman), **I agree** (qo'shilaman), **I apologise** (uzr so'rayman), **I suggest** (taklif qilaman), **I think** (menimcha), **I hope** (umid qilaman).

sentences.text: **I promise** to call you every evening.
sentences.translation: Har kuni kechqurun qo'ng'iroq qilishga **va'da beraman**.

sentences.text: **I agree** with you completely.
**I think** this restaurant is very good.
Madina **thinks** the film is too long.
We **hope** you're well.
Sorry — **I apologise** for the mistake in your bill.
Tom **agrees** with his wife about most things.
sentences.translation: Tom ko'p masalada xotini bilan **bir fikrda**.

sentences.text: Honestly, **I suggest** the fish — it's fresh today.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, baliqni **tavsiya qilaman** — bugun yangi.

sentences.text: My parents **hope** to visit London next year.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam kelasi yili Londonga borishga **umid qilishadi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **says** the exam is easy, but Dilnoza **thinks** it's very difficult.
sentences.translation: Bekzod imtihon oson, **deydi**, Dilnozaning **fikricha** esa u juda qiyin.

examples.title: Mixed: Dilnoza's ordinary week
examples.description: Mustahkamlash: I / we / they va he / she / it shakllari, `-s` / `-es` / `-ies`, chastota so'zlari va vaqt iboralari bitta hikoyada.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **lives** in Tashkent with her husband and two children.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza eri va ikki farzandi bilan Toshkentda **yashaydi**.

sentences.text: She **teaches** chemistry at a school near her house.
sentences.translation: U uyi yaqinidagi maktabda kimyodan **dars beradi**.

sentences.text: Every morning she **gets up** at half past five.
sentences.translation: Har tongda u soat besh yarimda **turadi**.

sentences.text: Her husband **drives** the children to school.
The children **love** their school, and they **have** lots of friends there.
sentences.translation: Bolalar maktabini juda **yaxshi ko'radi**, u yerda do'stlari ham **ko'p**.

sentences.text: On Wednesdays Dilnoza **finishes** work early and **goes** swimming.
sentences.translation: Chorshanba kunlari Dilnoza ishni erta **tugatib**, suzishga **boradi**.

sentences.text: Her son **plays** chess, and her daughter **studies** music.
sentences.translation: O'g'li shaxmat **o'ynaydi**, qizi esa musiqa bilan **shug'ullanadi**.

sentences.text: In the evening the family usually **has** dinner together.
sentences.translation: Kechqurun oila odatda birga kechki ovqat **qiladi**.

sentences.text: At the weekend they often **visit** Dilnoza's parents in Chirchiq.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari ular ko'pincha Chirchiqdagi Dilnozaning ota-onasinikiga **borishadi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **says** her life is busy but happy.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza hayotim band, lekin baxtli, deb **aytadi**.
